from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # identify 2-cell monochrome components (excluding the 2 boundary)
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
      for c in range(w):
        v=g[r][c]
        if v in (0,2) or (r,c) in seen: continue
        q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
        while q:
          x,y=q.pop(); comp.append((x,y))
          for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
            z=(x+dx,y+dy)
            if 0<=z[0]<h and 0<=z[1]<w and z not in seen and g[z[0]][z[1]]==v:
              seen.add(z); q.append(z)
        comps.append((v,comp))
    # direction toward the full line of 2s
    toward_up = all(v==2 for v in g[0])
    dr= -1 if toward_up else 1
    # nearest object to boundary moves first, guaranteeing packed stacks
    comps.sort(key=lambda vc: (min(r for r,c in vc[1]) if dr<0 else -max(r for r,c in vc[1])))
    # Clear pieces from board, then move each rigidly
    for v, cells in comps:
      for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=0
    settled=[]
    for v,cells in comps:
      cells=[tuple(x) for x in cells]
      while True:
        nxt=[(r+dr,c) for r,c in cells]
        if any(r<0 or r>=h or c<0 or c>=w for r,c in nxt): break
        # 2 line is fixed barrier, and already-settled pieces block
        if any(g[r][c]!=0 for r,c in nxt): break
        cells=nxt
      for r,c in cells: g[r][c]=v
    return g
